fee_notes: Fixed $20,000 Initial Franchise Fee plus Territory Fee (greater of $18,000 or $1,000 per 10,000 households). Optional Market Development Fee for unoccupied developed markets ($15,380-$270,000 in 2025). 10% veteran discount available.
raw_excerpt: All Closets By Design franchisees pay a lump sum initial franchise fee of $20,000 (the "Initial Franchise Fee").
